turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My partner's been on my case about it, to be honest. I don't know why it's such a big deal.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. Has he explained why he's concerned?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: He just says I'm drinking too much, and that it's affecting my life. But I can handle it, I'm not like that.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. Have you considered why your partner's concerned?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (scoffs slightly) Oh, I'm sure he's just worried I'm gonna lose my job or something. I mean, I'm fine. I'm still working, still paying the bills... (pauses, looks away)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It's understandable that your partner's concerned. I don't think it's fair to dismiss his worries.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) Look, I get it. But what's it to you? You're not my partner. Can't he just leave me alone about it? (crosses arms, slightly defensive)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand that you want your partner to leave you alone about it. But it's important to consider the reasons behind his concern.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs, looks down) Fine. If I'm being honest, there are some pretty bad mornings after. And the weekends... (pauses, trails off)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. Have you considered how this may be affecting your daily life?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (looks up, slightly guarded) Like what? I still go to work, I still take care of things... (pauses, thinks for a moment) Okay, fine. Some days I'm a little shaky, and I might need a drink at lunch to calm down. But that's not a big deal, right?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. But it's important to consider the potential consequences of drinking heavily on a daily basis.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (looks away, slightly irritated) Consequences? Like what? I'm still standing, aren't I? (pauses, voice lowers slightly) Okay, okay. Maybe some days I'm not as sharp as I used to be. But it's not like I'm hurting anyone.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. But it's important to consider how this may affect you in the future.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs, looks down) Yeah, yeah. I get it. My partner's worried I'm gonna lose my job, I'm gonna ruin my health... (pauses, shakes head) Look, can we just focus on what's going on now? I'm not exactly thrilled about coming here and talking about all this.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Of course. I understand. Let's focus on what's going on now. Can you tell me more about why your partner's concerned?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (looks up, slightly softer) It's just... I don't know, things have been really stressful lately. Work's been a nightmare, and my partner's been on my case about this drinking thing. I guess I have been drinking more than I used to. (pauses, thinks for a moment) I mean, I'll have a few beers after work, and then maybe a few more when I get home... (trails off, looks away)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. Have you considered seeking help for this?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) Help for what? I'm not an addict or anything. I just drink to unwind, okay? (pauses, looks down) But, I don't know... maybe I should try to cut back or something. (looks up, slightly hesitant) Do you think that's a good idea?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It's a good idea to consider seeking help for this.
